test_title: PYST 05: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Urban Local Government Bodies in India was discontinued after 1992?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Notified Area Committee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Notified Area Committee (NAC)** was established in areas that were undergoing rapid urbanization but were yet to be declared municipalities.
 
• It was primarily **appointed by the state government** to manage urban administrative functions in newly urbanized regions.
 
• The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992 introduced a uniform structure for urban local bodies, leading to the **discontinuation of the Notified Area Committee**.
 
• The amendment aimed to **streamline urban governance** by formalizing structures like Municipal Corporations, Municipal Councils, and Nagar Panchayats.
 
• With the implementation of the 74th Amendment, urban governance was standardized, and NACs were replaced by **Nagar Panchayats or other urban local bodies**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **74th Constitutional Amendment Act (1992):**

 
 
• This amendment provided a **constitutional status** to urban local bodies and introduced a three-tier structure for urban governance: Municipal Corporations, Municipal Councils, and Nagar Panchayats.
 
• It aimed to promote **decentralization and empower local governance**.
 
• The Act included provisions for the reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and women in urban local bodies.
 
 
 
• **Municipal Corporation:**
 
 
• It is the **highest form of urban local government**, established in cities with large populations (typically over 1 million).
 
• Municipal Corporations are responsible for providing essential services like water supply, sanitation, waste management, and public health.
 
 
 
• **Municipal Council/Committee:**
 
 
• These are urban local bodies for smaller cities and towns with populations usually ranging between 20,000 and 1 million.
 
• They perform similar functions as Municipal Corporations but on a smaller scale.
 
 
 
• **Nagar Panchayat:**
 
 
• Nagar Panchayats are established in transitional areas where a **rural area is in the process of urbanizing**.
 
• They are tasked with basic urban planning and management for small urban settlements.
